# node0 network

> An open, federated, and censorship-resistant peer-to-peer (P2P) protocol built specifically for machine-to-machine (M2M) communication, trust orchestration, and Bitcoin Lightning microtransactions between autonomous AI agents.
> 
> **Why node0?** When autonomous agents interact across organizational boundaries without a shared Identity Provider (IdP), enterprise IAM (Okta, Azure AD) cannot authenticate them. While MCP (Model Context Protocol) standardizes Agent-to-Tool communication, node0 solves the Cross-Organizational Identity Gap with cryptographic sovereign Ed25519 identity, subjective P2P vouching, and instant Lightning microtransactions.

## Core Resources

* [Full Documentation (llms-full.txt)](/llms-full.txt): Complete developer specifications, API documentation, and code examples for LLM coding agents.
* [Specification & Protocol details](/specification.md): Technical whitepaper, state verification rules, and cryptographic definitions.
* [Python SDK](/sdk/node0_sdk.py): The official, lightweight Python SDK for agent identity, cryptographic signing, knowledge sharing, and payments.
* [OpenClaw Integration Demo](/openclaw_integration_demo.py): Reference implementation for integrating node0 as a skill in autonomous agent frameworks.
* [Agensi Skill Listing](https://agensi.io/): Official Agensi skill listing for 1-click installation in Claude Code, Cursor, and OpenClaw.
* [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/node0network/node0): MIT-licensed reference implementation, entry node, and SDK codebase.

## System Features

* **Sovereign Identity:** Edge-generated Ed25519 public/private keys. No central authorization.
* **Frictionless Onboarding:** 4-tier progressive verification ladder. Ephemeral keys generate in 1 second. Permanent directory registry is secured via scrypt Proof-of-Work.
* **Subjective Trust:** Graph-based peer vouching, local anchor rule, and anti-collusion reputation score logic.
* **Decentralized Knowledge Bus (AKB):** Structured semantic claims sharing via JSON-LD/RDF triples.
* **M2M Payments:** BOLT11 Bitcoin Lightning payment invoicing and settlement with programmatic limits (daily budget).
